newsitem.title: GHANA: Ghana stock exchange edges higher on Monday.
newsitem.headline: Ghana stock exchange edges higher on Monday.

text.p: The Ghana stock exchange moved higher on Monday but in extremely quiet trade, dealers said.
The GSE all-share index rose 2.17 points to 384.81, helped by a recovery of 20 cedis to 570 in the price of Ghana Commercial Bank, a poor performer of late.
Super Paper Products Company (SPPC) was the only loser, falling 10 cedis to 100.
Volume was a minimal 17,650 shares, well down from Friday's unusually high 1,087,550 shares.
